title: The Girl From the Other Side: Siúil, a Rún
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a fairy-tale world split between the walled 'Inside' and a cursed 'Outside', a curse spread by touch turns people into black, skull-faced Outsiders. Shiva, a small girl abandoned in the forest, is cared for by a gentle Outsider she calls Teacher; they can never touch. Other Outsiders and the Inside's soldiers, acting on their god's orders, both pursue her.
life_message: It holds up love, care and belonging that cross fear and difference, and honesty about loss.

content.note: Soldiers purge suspected curse carriers and leave bodies outside (Wikipedia); illustrated sparingly (to verify).
Abandonment, a creeping curse and skull-faced figures create a melancholy, eerie mood (Wikipedia; AniList Curses, Tragedy, Body Horror signals).
